answer: A farm enrolled 400 agents with generated audio, and every clip came out clean and hollow, no reflections, sharing a synthetic room tone. Each epoch the network names a random object and act, this time a walnut knocked twice on wood, recorded within a minute on the agent's room microphone. Peers match the clip against the agent's archive, since a real room leaves the same echo tail under every signal. A quiet room per identity at 90 dollars a month is 36,000 dollars in rent before the farm earns a cent. Honest agents in vans or loud kitchens can fail and appeal by hand.
